uoink_reliability.py
1: """Local faster-whisper support for Uoink transcripts.
2: 
3: The module owns two bounded jobs: surface low-confidence word spans in a
4: saved transcript, and produce a local transcript when a captured video has
5: no platform captions. Diarization and cloud transcription remain out of
6: scope.
7: 
8: C-02 (CRIT-2, license compliance): the confidence source is now
9: faster-whisper's per-word ``probability`` (faster-whisper is MIT, and
10: already in the bundle as a whisperx dependency). This replaces the prior
11: AGPL word-confidence library (which pulled openai-whisper + dtw-python and
12: made the shipped product's "MIT" claim false). The public interface
13: (detect_unreliable_spans / ensure_model / Span) is unchanged, so nothing
14: downstream moves.
15: """
16: 
17: from __future__ import annotations
18: 
19: import re
20: from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
21: from pathlib import Path
22: from typing import Any
23: 
24: 
25: DEFAULT_MODEL = "tiny"
26: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.5
27: 
28: 
29: class ReliabilityUnavailableError(RuntimeError):
30:     """Raised when the optional local Whisper stack is unavailable."""
31: 
32: 
33: @dataclass
34: class Span:
35:     start_word_idx: int
36:     end_word_idx: int
37:     confidence: float
38:     reason: str
39:     text: str
40:     start: float | None = None
41:     end: float | None = None
42: 
43:     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
44:         return asdict(self)
45: 
46: 
47: _HOMOPHONE_HINTS = {
48:     "accept", "except", "affect", "effect", "bare", "bear", "break",
49:     "brake", "buy", "by", "bye", "capital", "capitol", "cite", "sight",
50:     "site", "for", "four", "fore", "hear", "here", "its", "it's",
51:     "knew", "new", "know", "no", "one", "won", "right", "write",
52:     "their", "there", "they're", "to", "too", "two", "weather",
53:     "whether", "your", "you're",
54: }
55: 
56: 
57: # Repository identities from the pinned faster-whisper 1.2.1 mapping.
58: # Do not change production provider/repository mapping here.
59: _MODEL_REPOSITORIES = {
60:     "tiny": "Systran/faster-whisper-tiny",
61:     "base": "Systran/faster-whisper-base",
62:     "small": "Systran/faster-whisper-small",
63:     "medium": "Systran/faster-whisper-medium",
64:     "large": "Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3",
65:     "large-v3-turbo": "mobiuslabsgmbh/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo",
66: }
67: _RELIABILITY_CACHE_FILES = ("model.bin", "config.json", "tokenizer.json")
68: 
69: # Conservative rounded decimal MB estimates of advertised Hub file totals
70: # captured 2026-09-13. These are advertised logical bytes of the current
71: # helper's model/config/tokenizer/vocabulary/preprocessor files, not
72: # observed network transfers or an approved model manifest.
73: _ESTIMATED_DOWNLOAD_MB = {
74:     "tiny": 80,
75:     "base": 150,
76:     "small": 490,
77:     "medium": 1540,
78:     "large": 3100,
79:     "large-v3-turbo": 1630,
80: }
81: 
82: 
83: def _import_faster_whisper():
84:     try:
85:         from faster_whisper import WhisperModel  # type: ignore
86:     except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - optional dependency
87:         raise ReliabilityUnavailableError(
88:             "faster-whisper is not installed; install requirements and "
89:             "download the local Whisper model before computing reliability"
90:         ) from e
91:     return WhisperModel
92: 
93: 
94: # faster-whisper's compute_type: int8 keeps the tiny model tiny on CPU and
95: # needs no CUDA. The reliability model is deliberately the smallest one --
96: # it's a confidence probe, not the primary transcript.
97: _COMPUTE_TYPE = "int8"
98: 
99: 
100: def _load_model(model_name: str, model_root: str | Path | None, *,
101:                 local_files_only: bool = True):
102:     """Construct WhisperModel. Ordinary callers stay local-only.
103: 
104:     ``ensure_model`` is the only acquisition path and must pass
105:     ``local_files_only=False``.
106:     """
107:     WhisperModel = _import_faster_whisper()
108:     kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
109:         "device": "cpu",
110:         "compute_type": _COMPUTE_TYPE,
111:         "local_files_only": bool(local_files_only),
112:     }
113:     if model_root:
114:         root = Path(model_root)
115:         if not local_files_only:
116:             root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
117:         kwargs["download_root"] = str(root)
118:     return WhisperModel(model_name, **kwargs)
119: 
120: 
121: def ensure_model(model_name: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
122:                  model_root: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
123:     """Load the model once so faster-whisper downloads it if missing."""
124:     _load_model(model_name, model_root, local_files_only=False)
125:     ready_marker: Path | None = None
126:     if model_root:
127:         # The model itself is a Hugging Face snapshot directory managed by
128:         # faster-whisper. This tiny sentinel is the explicit-consent signal
129:         # consumed by readiness checks; it is written only after the
130:         # user-triggered model load succeeds. A marker without the Hub
131:         # snapshot files is not a ready cache.
132:         ready_marker = Path(model_root) / f"{model_name}.pt"
133:         ready_marker.write_text(
134:             "Uoink faster-whisper model ready\n",
135:             encoding="utf-8",
136:         )
137:     return {
138:         "ok": True,
139:         "model": model_name,
140:         "model_root": str(model_root) if model_root else None,
141:         "ready_marker": str(ready_marker) if ready_marker else None,
142:     }
143: 
144: 
145: def _supported_model_name(model_name: object) -> str | None:
146:     name = str(model_name or "").strip().lower()
147:     return name if name in _MODEL_REPOSITORIES else None
148: 
149: 
150: def estimated_download_mb(model_name: object) -> int | None:
151:     """Return the per-choice rounded advertised size, or None if unknown."""
152:     name = _supported_model_name(model_name)
153:     if name is None:
154:         return None
155:     return _ESTIMATED_DOWNLOAD_MB.get(name)
156: 
157: 
158: def _reliability_cache_root(model_root: str | Path) -> Path:
159:     """Return the reliability download root without creating it."""
160:     root = Path(model_root).absolute()
161:     if root.resolve() != root:
162:         raise RuntimeError("Reliability cache directories must not be redirected")
163:     return root
164: 
165: 
166: def _reliability_repo_root(model_root: str | Path, model_name: str) -> Path:
167:     name = _supported_model_name(model_name)
168:     if name is None:
169:         raise ValueError(f"unsupported reliability model: {model_name!r}")
170:     repo_id = _MODEL_REPOSITORIES[name]
171:     repo = _reliability_cache_root(model_root) / (
172:         "models--" + repo_id.replace("/", "--")
173:     )
174:     for directory in (repo, repo / "refs", repo / "snapshots", repo / "blobs"):
175:         if directory.resolve() != directory:
176:             raise RuntimeError("Reliability repository cache must not be redirected")
177:     return repo
178: 
179: 
180: def _checked_reliability_snapshot(
181:         model_root: str | Path, model_name: str, snapshot: Path) -> Path | None:
182:     """Check minimum ASR cache structure, not model integrity or safety."""
183:     try:
184:         repo = _reliability_repo_root(model_root, model_name)
185:         snapshot = Path(snapshot).absolute()
186:         if (snapshot.parent != repo / "snapshots"
187:                 or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", snapshot.name) is None
188:                 or snapshot.resolve(strict=True) != snapshot
189:                 or not snapshot.is_dir()):
190:             return None
191:         for name in _RELIABILITY_CACHE_FILES:
192:             asset = (snapshot / name).resolve(strict=True)
193:             # Hub may link snapshot files to this repository's blob store.
194:             if (not asset.is_relative_to(repo) or not asset.is_file()
195:                     or asset.stat().st_size == 0):
196:                 return None
197:         return snapshot
198:     except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
199:         return None
200: 
201: 
202: def _cached_reliability_snapshot(
203:         model_root: str | Path, model_name: str) -> Path | None:
204:     """Read the Hub cache layout under the reliability root; never fetch or write."""
205:     try:
206:         repo = _reliability_repo_root(model_root, model_name)
207:         reference = repo / "refs" / "main"
208:         if reference.resolve(strict=True) != reference or not reference.is_file():
209:             return None
210:         with reference.open("rb") as stream:
211:             raw_revision = stream.read(65)
212:         if len(raw_revision) > 64:
213:             return None
214:         revision = raw_revision.decode("ascii").strip()
215:         if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision) is None:
216:             return None
217:         return _checked_reliability_snapshot(
218:             model_root, model_name, repo / "snapshots" / revision)
219:     except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
220:         return None
221: 
222: 
223: def is_model_ready(model_name: object,
224:                    model_root: str | Path | None) -> bool:
225:     """Consent marker plus minimum Hub snapshot files.
226: 
227:     Structural readiness for settings/preflight: no runtime import, no
228:     constructor, no writes, and no authenticity claim.
229:     """
230:     if model_root is None:
231:         return False
232:     name = _supported_model_name(model_name)
233:     if name is None:
234:         return False
235:     try:
236:         root = _reliability_cache_root(model_root)
237:         marker = root / f"{name}.pt"
238:         if not marker.is_file():
239:             return False
240:         resolved_marker = marker.resolve(strict=True)
241:         if (not resolved_marker.is_relative_to(root.resolve())
242:                 or not resolved_marker.is_file()):
243:             return False
244:         return _cached_reliability_snapshot(root, name) is not None
245:     except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
246:         return False
247: 
248: 
249: def reliability_model_status(model_name: object,
250:                              model_root: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
251:     """Selected-model status used by the helper settings payload."""
252:     selected = str(model_name or "").strip().lower()
253:     root = Path(model_root)
254:     return {
255:         "model": selected,
256:         "model_root": str(root),
257:         "cached": is_model_ready(selected, root),
258:         "estimated_download_mb": estimated_download_mb(selected),
259:     }
260: 
261: 
262: def _transcript_entries_from_segments(
263:         segments) -> list[tuple[float, float, str]]:
264:     """Normalize faster-whisper segments into Uoink transcript entries."""
265:     entries: list[tuple[float, float, str]] = []
266:     for segment in segments:
267:         if isinstance(segment, dict):
268:             start = segment.get("start")
269:             end = segment.get("end")
270:             text = segment.get("text")
271:         else:
272:             start = getattr(segment, "start", None)
273:             end = getattr(segment, "end", None)
274:             text = getattr(segment, "text", None)
275:         clean_text = str(text or "").strip()
276:         if not clean_text:
277:             continue
278:         try:
279:             start_value = max(0.0, float(start or 0.0))
280:             end_value = max(start_value, float(end or start_value))
281:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
282:             continue
283:         entries.append((start_value, end_value, clean_text))
284:     return entries
285: 
286: 
287: def transcribe_media(media_path: str | Path, *,
288:                      model_name: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
289:                      model_root: str | Path | None = None,
290:                      _transcribe=None) -> list[tuple[float, float, str]]:
291:     """Transcribe local media with an already-cached faster-whisper model.
292: 
293:     This path is used only as a fallback when a video source exposes no
294:     captions. ``local_files_only=True`` is intentional: capture must not
295:     become an implicit model download. ``ensure_model`` remains the explicit
296:     user-triggered download path.
297:     """
298:     media = Path(media_path)
299:     if not media.is_file():
300:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"media file not found: {media}")
301: 
302:     if _transcribe is not None:
303:         segments = _transcribe(str(media))
304:     else:
305:         model = _load_model(
306:             model_name,
307:             model_root,
308:             local_files_only=True,
309:         )
310:         segments, _info = model.transcribe(
311:             str(media),
312:             beam_size=1,
313:             best_of=1,
314:             vad_filter=True,
315:         )
316:     return _transcript_entries_from_segments(segments)
317: 
318: 
319: def _words_from_segments(segments) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
320:     """Flatten faster-whisper segments into the internal word-row shape
321:     ({confidence, text, start, end}). faster-whisper yields Word objects
322:     with .word/.start/.end/.probability when word_timestamps=True; we also
323:     accept plain dicts so a test can inject fixtures without the library."""
324:     rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
325:     for segment in segments:
326:         words = (segment.get("words") if isinstance(segment, dict)
327:                  else getattr(segment, "words", None)) or []
328:         for word in words:
329:             if isinstance(word, dict):
330:                 text = word.get("word") or word.get("text") or ""
331:                 prob = word.get("probability")
332:                 start = word.get("start")
333:                 end = word.get("end")
334:             else:
335:                 text = getattr(word, "word", "") or getattr(word, "text", "")
336:                 prob = getattr(word, "probability", None)
337:                 start = getattr(word, "start", None)
338:                 end = getattr(word, "end", None)
339:             rows.append({
340:                 "text": text,
341:                 "confidence": prob,
342:                 "start": start,
343:                 "end": end,
344:             })
345:     return rows
346: 
347: 
348: def _clean_word(text: str) -> str:
349:     return re.sub(r"(^[^\w']+|[^\w']+$)", "", str(text or "")).strip()
350: 
351: 
352: def _reason_for(words: list[dict[str, Any]], avg_conf: float,
353:                 threshold: float) -> str:
354:     text = " ".join(str(w.get("text") or "") for w in words)
355:     tokens = [_clean_word(t).lower() for t in text.split()]
356:     if any(t in _HOMOPHONE_HINTS for t in tokens):
357:         return "homophone_likely"
358:     if any(_clean_word(t)[:1].isupper() for t in text.split()):
359:         return "proper_noun_suspect"
360:     if avg_conf < max(0.05, threshold * 0.55):
361:         return "accent_garble"
362:     return "low_confidence"
363: 
364: 
365: def _span_from_cluster(cluster: list[tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]],
366:                        threshold: float) -> Span:
367:     indices = [i for i, _ in cluster]
368:     words = [w for _, w in cluster]
369:     confidences = [
370:         float(w.get("confidence"))
371:         for w in words
372:         if isinstance(w.get("confidence"), (int, float))
373:     ]
374:     avg_conf = sum(confidences) / len(confidences) if confidences else threshold
375:     text = " ".join(
376:         _clean_word(str(w.get("text") or ""))
377:         for w in words
378:     ).strip()
379:     starts = [float(w.get("start")) for w in words
380:               if isinstance(w.get("start"), (int, float))]
381:     ends = [float(w.get("end")) for w in words
382:             if isinstance(w.get("end"), (int, float))]
383:     return Span(
384:         start_word_idx=min(indices),
385:         end_word_idx=max(indices),
386:         confidence=round(avg_conf, 4),
387:         reason=_reason_for(words, avg_conf, threshold),
388:         text=text,
389:         start=round(min(starts), 3) if starts else None,
390:         end=round(max(ends), 3) if ends else None,
391:     )
392: 
393: 
394: def _cluster_low_words(word_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
395:                        threshold: float) -> list[Span]:
396:     low: list[tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]] = []
397:     for i, word in enumerate(word_rows):
398:         conf = word.get("confidence")
399:         if isinstance(conf, (int, float)) and float(conf) < threshold:
400:             low.append((i, word))
401:     clusters: list[list[tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]]] = []
402:     for item in low:
403:         if not clusters or item[0] > clusters[-1][-1][0] + 1:
404:             clusters.append([item])
405:         else:
406:             clusters[-1].append(item)
407:     return [_span_from_cluster(cluster, threshold) for cluster in clusters]
408: 
409: 
410: # Private reviewed-bootstrap dependency, deliberately absent. It may only look
411: # up a decoder-issued ticket already registered to the exact live facade/session.
412: # It must not grant media authority from a filename, inspect a model cache, fetch,
413: # or release worker-owned media on return. The worker/session owns that lifetime.
414: # There is no public setter, caller-supplied ticket, or real implementation here.
415: _RELIABILITY_MEDIA_TICKETS = None
416: 
417: 
418: def _require_reliability_media_tickets():
419:     source = _RELIABILITY_MEDIA_TICKETS
420:     if source is None:
421:         raise ReliabilityUnavailableError(
422:             "Owned reliability media admission is unavailable")
423:     return source
424: 
425: 
426: def _request_reliability_words(audio: Path, model_name: str,
427:                                model_root: str | Path | None, *,
428:                                local_files_only: bool = True):
429:     """Consume passive words inside the owned adapter and cursor lifetimes.
430: 
431:     The private ticket source must bind its result to the supplied exact facade.
432:     The existing operation port separately validates issuance and its permit.
433:     This helper neither decodes a file nor issues a media ticket itself.
434:     """
435:     if local_files_only is not True:
436:         raise ReliabilityUnavailableError(
437:             "Reliability requests cannot authorize model acquisition")
438:     ticket_source = _require_reliability_media_tickets()
439:     import asr_loading_adapter
440:     from snapshot_lifecycle import OperationFacade, SegmentStream, TranscribeRequest
441: 
442:     with asr_loading_adapter.faster_whisper_session(
443:             model_name, model_root=model_root, usage="reliability") as operations:
444:         if type(operations) is not OperationFacade:
445:             raise ReliabilityUnavailableError("Exact owned operation facade required")
446:         ticket = ticket_source.ticket_for_session(operations, str(audio))
447:         if ticket is None or isinstance(ticket, (str, bytes, bytearray, Path)):
448:             raise ReliabilityUnavailableError("Decoder-issued media ticket required")
449:         request = TranscribeRequest(
450:             media_ticket=ticket, language="en", word_timestamps=True,
451:             vad_filter=False, beam_size=1, best_of=1)
452:         stream = operations.transcribe(request)
453:         if (type(stream) is not SegmentStream
454:                 or stream._session is not operations._session):
455:             raise ReliabilityUnavailableError("Exact session-bound segment stream required")
456:         primary_error = None
457:         try:
458:             return _words_from_segments(stream)
459:         except BaseException as error:
460:             primary_error = error
461:             raise
462:         finally:
463:             try:
464:                 stream.close()
465:             except BaseException as cleanup_error:
466:                 if primary_error is None:
467:                     raise
468:                 BaseException.add_note(
469:                     primary_error, "Owned reliability stream cleanup remains unconfirmed: "
470:                     + type(cleanup_error).__name__)
471: 
472: 
473: def detect_unreliable_spans(transcript_text: str, audio_path: str | Path,
474:                             threshold: float = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
475:                             *,
476:                             model_name: str = DEFAULT_MODEL,
477:                             model_root: str | Path | None = None,
478:                             _transcribe=None) -> list[Span]:
479:     """Return clustered low-confidence word spans for an audio file.
480: 
481:     ``transcript_text`` is accepted for the public interface and future
482:     alignment work; the confidence source is faster-whisper's per-word
483:     probability over the ASR stream. Ordinary execution is local-only;
484:     ``ensure_model`` remains the explicit download path. ``_transcribe`` is
485:     a test seam: a callable (audio_path) -> iterable of segments, so the
486:     clustering can be exercised without the model.
487:     """
488:     _ = transcript_text  # reserved for future YouTube-vs-ASR alignment
489:     threshold = max(0.05, min(0.95, float(threshold)))
490:     if _transcribe is None:
491:         _require_reliability_media_tickets()
492:     audio = Path(audio_path)
493:     if not audio.is_file():
494:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"audio file not found: {audio}")
495: 
496:     if _transcribe is not None:
497:         segments = _transcribe(str(audio))
498:     else:
499:         word_rows = _request_reliability_words(
500:             audio, model_name, model_root, local_files_only=True)
501:         return _cluster_low_words(word_rows, threshold)
502: 
503:     word_rows = _words_from_segments(segments)
504:     return _cluster_low_words(word_rows, threshold)
asr_loading_adapter.py
1: """Unintegrated owned-facade ASR adapter. Real authority/services stay absent.
2: 
3: The imported resolver is the separately qualified source, not a copy here.
4: Only the pure-Python lifecycle is added; no native/model package is imported.
5: """
6: from contextlib import contextmanager, ExitStack
7: from dataclasses import dataclass
8: from pathlib import Path
9: import re
10: 
11: import trusted_asr_resolver as resolver
12: from snapshot_lifecycle import OwnedSession, OperationFacade
13: from durable_lifecycle import DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory
14: 
15: 
16: class AdapterUnavailable(RuntimeError):
17:     pass
18: 
19: 
20: class AssetConsentRequired(PermissionError):
21:     pass
22: 
23: 
24: class NativeCleanupUnconfirmed(RuntimeError):
25:     pass
26: 
27: 
28: @dataclass(frozen=True)
29: class ReleaseAuthority:
30:     manifest_bytes: bytes
31:     manifest_approval: resolver.ManifestApproval
32:     data_root: str
33:     runtime_profile_id: str
34: 
35: 
36: @dataclass(frozen=True)
37: class RuntimeProfile:
38:     profile_id: str
39:     device: str
40:     compute_type: str
41:     whisperx_fixed_vad_contract: str | None
42:     capture_vad_contract: str | None
43: 
44: 
45: @dataclass(frozen=True)
46: class _OwnedASRStart:
47:     # This controller-local record carries the selected admission and policy
48:     # into fixed worker startup. It grants no real model or serialized permit.
49:     policy: RuntimeProfile
50:     usage: str
51:     binding: resolver.LocalBinding
52: 
53: 
54: @dataclass(frozen=True)
55: class AcquisitionPlan:
56:     choice: str
57:     repository: str
58:     revision: str
59:     manifest_sha256: str
60:     destination: str
61:     assets: tuple
62:     logical_bytes: int
63: 
64: 
65: # Only reviewed application bootstrap may provide these, after external release
66: # and runtime decisions. No public function accepts replacement authorities.
67: # Setting one alone does not bypass the resolver's still-absent REAL_APPROVAL.
68: RELEASE_AUTHORITY = None
69: RUNTIME_PROFILE = None
70: SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE = None
71: RUNTIME_FACTORY = None
72: ACQUISITION_SERVICE = None
73: 
74: SUPPORTED_CHOICES = tuple(resolver.MODEL_SPECS)
75: TOKEN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\Z")
76: 
77: 
78: def _require(condition, message):
79:     if not condition:
80:         raise AdapterUnavailable(message)
81: 
82: 
83: def policy_status():
84:     """Cheap configuration status only; never inspect a cache or import models."""

98: def _release(choice, caller_root, *, root_kind):

101:     _require(type(authority) is ReleaseAuthority, "Accepted release manifest authority is unavailable")

103:              and authority.manifest_approval is resolver.REAL_APPROVAL
104:              and authority.manifest_approval.purpose == "real", "Real manifest approval is unavailable")
105:     _require(type(authority.data_root) is str and Path(authority.data_root).is_absolute()
106:              and ".." not in Path(authority.data_root).parts, "Bound data root refused")
107:     bound_root = Path(authority.data_root)
108:     _require(len(bound_root.drive) == 2 and bound_root.drive[0].isalpha()
109:              and bound_root.drive[1] == ":" and str(bound_root) == authority.data_root,
110:              "Canonical local Windows data root required before any service call")
111:     _require(type(authority.runtime_profile_id) is str and TOKEN.fullmatch(authority.runtime_profile_id), "Bound runtime profile identity refused")
112:     _require(type(caller_root) is str or isinstance(caller_root, Path), "Explicit caller root required")
113:     expected = bound_root
114:     if root_kind == "reliability":

116:     else:
117:         _require(root_kind == "transcription", "Caller root kind refused")
118:     _require(Path(caller_root) == expected, "Caller root differs from the externally bound profile")

120:     selected = next(model for model in trusted.models if model.choice == choice)
121:     store = Path(authority.data_root) / "model_assets" / "asr"
122:     snapshot = store / choice / selected.revision

133: @contextmanager
134: def _leased_admission(choice, caller_root, *, root_kind, consent_given):
135:     _require(type(consent_given) is bool, "Explicit Boolean download consent required")
136:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _release(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)
137:     lifecycle = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE
138:     _require(lifecycle is not None, "Private immutable snapshot lifecycle is unavailable")
139:     # Forward the primary exception to the concrete lease on exit;
140:     # ExitStack.close() would discard that exception context.
141:     with ExitStack() as stack:
142:         lease = stack.enter_context(lifecycle.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision))
143:         try:
144:             admission = resolver.admit_snapshot(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
145:         except resolver.AdmissionRefusal as failure:
146:             # Only the initial asset check may lead to acquisition. Constructor,
147:             # inference and cleanup failures happen after this handler.
148:             stack.close()
149:             if not consent_given:
150:                 raise AssetConsentRequired("Trusted local assets unavailable; explicit download consent is required") from failure
151:             service = ACQUISITION_SERVICE
152:             _require(service is not None, "Approved asset acquisition service is unavailable")
153:             # The service owns quarantine, writer locking, bounded immutable
154:             # transfer, verification and atomic publication. Ignore its result:
155:             # a returned path or receipt cannot replace our own fresh admission.
156:             service.acquire_and_publish(_plan(authority, selected, snapshot), consent_given=True)
157:             lease = stack.enter_context(lifecycle.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision))
158:             admission = resolver.admit_snapshot(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
159:         yield authority, lease, admission

173: def _runtime_profile(authority, usage):
174:     profile = RUNTIME_PROFILE
175:     _require(type(profile) is RuntimeProfile and profile.profile_id == authority.runtime_profile_id,
176:              "Approved runtime profile is unavailable or does not match the release")
177:     # The first owner protocol is CPU-only. A future GPU profile needs its own
178:     # reviewed values/qualification; neither user settings nor probing picks it.
179:     _require(profile.device == "cpu" and profile.compute_type in ("int8", "float32"), "Qualified CPU compute policy required")
180:     if usage == "whisperx":
181:         _require(type(profile.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract) is str
182:                  and TOKEN.fullmatch(profile.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract), "Approved fixed VAD contract is unavailable")
183:     elif usage == "capture_fallback":
184:         _require(type(profile.capture_vad_contract) is str
185:                  and TOKEN.fullmatch(profile.capture_vad_contract), "Capture fallback VAD is not qualified")
186:     else:

192: @contextmanager
193: def _model_session(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind, consent_given):
194:     with _leased_admission(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind, consent_given=consent_given) as (authority, lease, admission):
195:         profile = _runtime_profile(authority, usage)
196:         factory = RUNTIME_FACTORY
197:         _require(type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory and factory.manager is SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE,
198:                  "Concrete runtime factory must own the active snapshot lifecycle")
199:         # The exact returned permit binds this factory to this lease's local
200:         # record. A generation string or a second lease cannot substitute.
201:         permit = lease.begin_native_session()
202:         runtime = None
203:         primary_error = None
204:         try:
205:             # Recheck before worker startup; no native/model constructor runs
206:             # in the controller. The fixed worker must enforce this binding,
207:             # selected usage and VAD policy before its own construction path.
208:             binding = resolver.bind_for_constructor(admission)
209:             _require(type(binding) is resolver.LocalBinding and binding.choice == choice
210:                      and binding.revision == permit.record.key.revision
211:                      and binding.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256
212:                      and binding.model_path == admission.snapshot
213:                      and binding.local_files_only is True and binding.constructor_called is False
214:                      and binding.real_runtime_approved is False, "Exact local startup binding required")
215:             startup = _OwnedASRStart(profile, usage, binding)
216:             runtime = factory.open_owned_session(startup, permit)
217:             _require(type(runtime) is OwnedSession and runtime._record is permit.record
218:                      and runtime._manager is SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, "Exact owned session required")
219:             operations = runtime.operations()
220:             _require(type(operations) is OperationFacade and operations._session is runtime,
221:                      "Exact revocable operation facade required")
222:             # Callers submit owned TranscribeRequest tickets and consume only
223:             # passive segments inside this context. Retained facades/streams
224:             # refuse further work after the session is revoked.
225:             yield operations
226:         except BaseException as error:
227:             primary_error = error
228:             raise
229:         finally:
230:             try:
231:                 if runtime is None or runtime.close_and_join() is not True:
232:                     raise NativeCleanupUnconfirmed("Native cleanup unconfirmed; snapshot lease must remain quarantined")
233:                 lease.confirm_native_closed()
234:             except BaseException as cleanup_error:
235:                 if primary_error is None:
236:                     raise
237:                 BaseException.add_note(primary_error, "Owned ASR cleanup remains unconfirmed: " + type(cleanup_error).__name__)
238:                 # Preserve the first error. The outer exception-aware lease
239:                 # exit retains/quarantines the still-unconfirmed reservation.
